# Ahmed Asl

> Portfolio of Ahmed Asl, an IoT and embedded systems engineer, teaching assistant, and technical educator based in Egypt.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://ahmed-ibrahim-asl.github.io/myPortflio/): Overview of Ahmed's embedded systems, IoT, robotics, research, teaching work, and free engineering tools.
- [Work](https://ahmed-ibrahim-asl.github.io/myPortflio/work/): Embedded firmware, robotics, IoT telemetry, secure hardware, OTA management, Flutter, and interface projects.
- [About](https://ahmed-ibrahim-asl.github.io/myPortflio/about/): Experience, university teaching, technical capabilities, publications, CV, and workshops.
- [Writing](https://ahmed-ibrahim-asl.github.io/myPortflio/writing/): Engineering field notes, Linux and cybersecurity walkthroughs, and the Learn With Me series.
- [Tools](https://ahmed-ibrahim-asl.github.io/myPortflio/tools/): Searchable electronics calculators and guided engineering workbenches.
- [Contact](https://ahmed-ibrahim-asl.github.io/myPortflio/contact/): Email and professional profiles.

## Free engineering tools

- [Electronics calculators](https://ahmed-ibrahim-asl.github.io/myPortflio/tools/#calculators): 36 interactive calculators for circuits, component values, timing, conversions, number systems, and engineering math.
- [Model Mission](https://ahmed-ibrahim-asl.github.io/myPortflio/tools/ai-script-generator/): Guided computer vision project builder with YOLO26, YOLOE open-vocabulary detection, monocular depth, and U-Net segmentation examples.
- [Sensor Code Generator](https://ahmed-ibrahim-asl.github.io/myPortflio/tools/sensor-code-generator/): Arduino, ESP-IDF, and PlatformIO code for sensors, I2C, SPI, UART, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, ESP-NOW, and other embedded interfaces.
- [PID Simulator](https://ahmed-ibrahim-asl.github.io/myPortflio/tools/pid-simulator/): Interactive proportional, integral, and derivative controller tuning.
- [Battery Life Estimator](https://ahmed-ibrahim-asl.github.io/myPortflio/tools/battery-estimator/): ESP32 runtime and average-current estimates from active and sleep duty cycles.
- [Security Mission](https://ahmed-ibrahim-asl.github.io/myPortflio/tools/security-command-builder/): Guided command builder for authorized security labs.

## Areas of work

- Embedded firmware in C and C++ for ESP32, ESP8266, Arduino, and AVR systems.
- IoT architecture, device connectivity, telemetry, networking, Linux, and Python.
- Robotics, sensor integration, secure access systems, and remotely operated vehicles.
- Flutter control interfaces, UI and UX design, and technical communication.
- University teaching in satellite communication, acoustics, digital and logic circuits, measurement, and sensors.

## Writing series

- OverTheWire Bandit walkthroughs: Linux, SSH, files, permissions, processes, and networking.
- Learn With Me: Linux, Python, Dart and Flutter, and Git.
